# GetTypeMissUse

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `GetTypeMissUseInspection`

Comparing the result of `gettype($v)` with a type-name string is a roundabout
(and typo-prone) way of calling the dedicated `is_*()` predicate. The rule
suggests the predicate, and flags strings that `gettype()` can never return.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,8,9} [Before]
<?php
function kinds($item, $mode = 'array') {
    $a = gettype($item->qty) === 'integer';
    $b = 'boolean' !== gettype($item);
    $c = gettype($item) == 'NULL';
    $d = gettype($item) != 'double';
    $e = gettype($item) === $mode;
    $f = gettype($item) === 'int';
    $g = gettype($item) === 'null';

    $h = gettype($item) === 'unknown type';
    $i = gettype($item) !== 'resource (closed)';
    $j = (gettype($item)) === 'string';
    $k = gettype($item) === ($item ? 'string' : 'object');
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j, $k];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function kinds($item, $mode = 'array') {
    $a = is_int($item->qty);
    $b = !is_bool($item);
    $c = is_null($item);
    $d = !is_float($item);
    $e = is_array($item);
    $f = gettype($item) === 'int';
    $g = gettype($item) === 'null';

    $h = gettype($item) === 'unknown type';
    $i = gettype($item) !== 'resource (closed)';
    $j = (gettype($item)) === 'string';
    $k = gettype($item) === ($item ? 'string' : 'object');
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j, $k];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;is_int($item-&gt;qty)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;!is_bool($item)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;is_null($item)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;!is_float($item)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 7: Use &#39;is_array($item)&#39; instead.</li>
<li>line 8: gettype() never returns &#39;int&#39;.</li>
<li>line 9: gettype() never returns &#39;null&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "GetTypeMissUse": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore GetTypeMissUse

/**
 * @noinspection GetTypeMissUseInspection
 */
```
